data.title: UN climate disaster fund moves to provide $20m aid for Nepal
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United Nations' (UN) climate loss and damage fund moved Thursday to provide US$20 million in aid sought by flood-stricken Nepal, the first time it has set aside money for any country, in a key test of the body's credibility.

data.title: Pentagon, Lockheed announce agreement for 850 F-35 jets over 10 years
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The Pentagon and Lockheed Martin on Thursday announced a 10-year agreement for the production of 850 F-35 warplanes, underscoring Washington's long-term commitment to the high-tech stealth aircraft.

data.title: American detained in Russia arrives in US: lawyer
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A retired US teacher freed by President Vladimir Putin after four years' detention in Russia for allegedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine has returned to the United States, his lawyer said Thursday.

data.title: French authorities seek to ban or curb fresh protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French authorities on Thursday imposed bans and restrictions aimed at fresh protests springing up in the wake of demonstrations last weekend that degenerated into the worst street violence in years.

data.title: Thai artist blends history and gaming in an installation that puts visitors in control
data.description: HONG KONG — Growing up, Thai artist Nawin Nuthong loved playing video games, especially Civilization, where players can create empires as historical leaders.

data.title: 'Solution from the heavens': Indonesians pray for rain as fires burn
data.description: SURABAYA (INDONESIA) - Indonesian schoolchildren prayed for rain on Thursday as another firefighter lost his life battling drought-fuelled blazes consuming forests and peatlands and blanketing parts of Southeast Asia in a sickening haze.

data.title: Nearly all coral reefs risk collapse in 50 years: IUCN
data.description: YEREVAN - Nearly all of the world's shallow-water coral reefs face an "extremely high risk" of collapse by 2075 due to climate change, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) warned Thursday.

data.title: Pattaya bike taxis switch back to orange after just five days in blue
data.description: Motorcycle taxi drivers in Chon Buri have been ordered to switch back to their traditional orange vests after just five days in blue ones. The reversal follows public concerns about road safety, the cost of new uniforms and the political implications of the colour change.

data.title: New movies out this week: Oct 22-28
data.description: Nine new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: 12 injured after tourist boat hits Sathorn pier pontoon
data.description: Twelve people, including five foreign tourists, were injured when a double-decker tourist boat struck a floating pontoon at Sathorn pier near Saphan Taksin BTS station in Bangkok on Thursday afternoon.

data.title: Targeted by Trump, ICC awarded top EU rights prize
data.description: STRASBOURG, France - Facing US sanctions, the International Criminal Court on Thursday was awarded the European Union’s top rights prize, in a show of support that risks upsetting President Donald Trump.

data.title: ONE Championship: Itsuki Hirata finds her way back with revenge over Jihin
data.description: Four years and seven months after Jihin Radzuan handed her a first professional defeat, Itsuki Hirata finally had her revenge. After everything that followed that night in Singapore, she also had reason to believe her career was moving forward again.

data.title: CP Group, True showcase ‘frontier tech’ at CP Innovation Exposition 2026
data.description: What will the future look like now that “frontier tech” — cutting-edge technologies once confined to research laboratories — is ready for real-world commercial applications? CP Group and True Corporation, led by Ekaraj Panjavinin, head of research and innovation at True Corporation Plc, explored this question at CP Innovation Exposition 2026. The event brought together technology partners for a panel discussion entitled “The New Frontier of Technology in Action”.

data.title: Ex-MP raises more concerns about gambling site
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha has urged law enforcement to trace funds linked to Shuffle.com, a gambling site blocked in Thailand, after the digital asset exchange Bitkub confirmed transactions exceeding 100 million baht involving 49 customers.

data.title: AI Is Changing More Than Our Jobs. It Is Changing How Organisations Create Value
data.description: Will AI take our jobs?

data.title: Leaders Discuss Roles in Peace and Reconciliation at “One South Sudan Peace Conference”
data.description: JUBA, South Sudan, Oct. 8 — The “One South Sudan Peace Conference: Beyond Our Camps, Bridging Our Future,” jointly hosted by the National Council of Traditional Authority Leaders (NCOTAL), the Community Empowerment for Progress Organization (CEPO), the Center for Inclusive Governance, Peace and Justice (CIGPJ), and HWPL, was held at the University of Juba.

data.title: Thailand, Beyond a Destination
data.description: As lives become less bound by borders, the concept of where we live is changing. Flexible work, greater connectivity and easier international travel allow global citizens to integrate where they were born, work and choose to build their life.

data.title: Son of Aung San Suu Kyi gets first phone call in five years
data.description: YANGON - The son of Aung San Suu Kyi said he spoke on Thursday to the detained former democratic leader of Myanmar for the first time in more than five years.

data.title: China slams ‘Cold War mentality’ in EU Arctic plan
data.description: BEIJING - China says it opposes “using Cold War mentality” to stoke conflict over the Arctic, after the European Union linked Beijing’s cooperation with Russia in the region to security concerns.

data.title: Luxury is the ability to escape
data.description: After years of conspicuous consumption, luxury is changing .

data.title: Customs to inspect all scrap metal containers for e-waste
data.description: The Thai Customs Department is physically inspecting every container declared as metal scrap as it steps up enforcement against illegal electronic waste imports, which have polluted the environment and threatened local livelihoods in the country’s eastern provinces.

data.title: Targeted by Trump, ICC in running for top EU rights prize
data.description: STRASBOURG — Facing US sanctions, the International Criminal Court is up for the European Union's top rights prize Thursday, with supporters pressing its case as a show of support for a fraying rules-based world order.

data.title: Lula seeks tit-for-tat annulment of Bolsonaro election candidacy
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's campaign requested the disqualification of right-wing rival Flavio Bolsonaro from the presidential race on Wednesday, a day after his opponent did the same.

data.title: Chinese suspects in Dubai abductions arrested in Bangkok
data.description: Two Chinese men have been arrested at luxury condominiums in Bangkok in connection with the abduction and detention of three people who were found dead in Dubai in June.
